## Research Highlights



### 🌊 Ocean–Atmosphere Interactions

Understanding how tropical ocean variability influences regional climates.

### 🌍 Compound Climate Extremes

Investigating how paired hazards, such as droughts-floods, and droughts-heatwaves interact to amplify socio-economic impacts.

### 🤖 Artificial Intelligence for Climate Science

Applying large language models to build global climate impact databases.
